newsitem.title: INDIA: United Front panel to meet on Saturday morning.
newsitem.headline: United Front panel to meet on Saturday morning.

text.p: India's ruling United Front coalition said its decision-making Steering Committee would meet at 8:30 a.m. (0300 GMT) on Saturday.
The panel had been expected to meet on Friday after a parliamentary vote of confidence in Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda.
"There will not be any formal or informal meeting tonight," United Front spokesman Jaipal Reddy told reporters.
